lines.1: 「I never said I wanted to come here, okay!?」
lines.2: 「Right. I'm the one who brought you here.」
lines.4: And so, I brought Konoe to my house.
lines.5: No one else was home. It was just me and Konoe.
lines.6: 「Oh... so this is your house, Tsushima.」
lines.8: 「Yeah, it is. It's been kept nice and clean.」
lines.9: 「But Kurogane-senpai is the one who does the cleaning, isn't she?」
lines.12: 「Now I'm worried it won't be tidy.」
lines.14: 「Huh. It's way better than I expected.」
lines.15: 「And here I was ready to clean it up for you if it was messy.」
lines.16: 「I wouldn't make you go to all that trouble.」
lines.17: 「Wait. Don't tell me Kurogane-senpai cleans your room too.」
lines.18: 「Of course not. It's my room, so I clean it myself.」
lines.23: 「Well, then... shall we watch a DVD?」
lines.24: I tried taking a little initiative.
lines.25: 「Must be nice, having a TV in your room.」
lines.26: 「You're an only child too, just like me. Why not ask for a TV of your own?」
lines.27: We watched the DVD while making small talk.
lines.30: I couldn't concentrate on the DVD.
lines.31: I stole a glance at Konoe.
lines.33: Damn. She'd been looking at me too.
lines.35: This was bad... Maybe we were both way too self-conscious.
